title: General satisfaction and miscellaneous issues
summary: The topic mixes broad satisfaction comments with unrelated customer circumstances, feature preferences, tech/display glitches, and operating instructions, so it lacks a single coherent aspect.

positive.summary: Positive reviews express general satisfaction with the car without naming specific features.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention personal difficulty entering or exiting vehicles and recent vehicle tech problems.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a preference for white interiors, display glitches, trouble opening the fuel door, and a CarPlay settings instruction without clear overall sentiment.

limitations: The fragments cover several unrelated subjects rather than one consistent product theme.
Many examples are vague or procedural, which limits sentiment interpretation and aspect-level conclusions.
Some negative content reflects customer personal circumstances rather than a clearly vehicle-specific issue.
